title: A background test run is not evidence when it launches: the evidence hook ignores Bash and Agent calls made with run_in_background
acceptance_criteria: a PostToolUse event for a Bash or Agent call whose input sets run_in_background, or whose response names a background task, records no evidence; a foreground test run still records tests and a failed one still records nothing; a commit after only a background test launch is stamped verified: none, not tests; reproduced in a test that fails on main

title: stats -rules judges a rule unused only over a window the usage log covers, and says how much of it the log does cover
acceptance_criteria: while the earliest served-id record is inside the unused window, no rule is listed as unused; the report says how many days of the window the log covers, how many rules are unserved so far, and the date the window will be covered; once the log covers the window the list is as before; checklist items are held too; reproduced in a test that fails on main

title: A rule's relative path cite resolves where its author meant it: as the tail of a tracked path, and a .../ elision is unknown, not dead
acceptance_criteria: a cited path missing from the repo root is not dead when a tracked file under the nugit root ends with it, which covers a cite under the record's scope component or bound paths as well as a global lesson's cite into one app; a cite with a ... segment is not judged; a cite no tracked file ends with is still dead; reproduced in a test that fails on main

title: A deployable with no source path is still a unit: its source dir is derived from its Dockerfile's COPY lines or build context, else the Dockerfile itself is its path, so model-drift and doctor see it
acceptance_criteria: a docker/ image that copies from one directory, or from several of which one matches its name, gets that directory as its source; a nested Dockerfile gets its own directory; otherwise the unit is the Dockerfile; model-drift fires when a PR changes the Dockerfile of an unmodeled image; doctor's coverage line lists it; confidence tiers are unchanged; reproduced in tests that fail on main
